title: Faster Learning under Relaxed Local Differential Privacy
abstract: arXiv:2609.05034v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We consider density estimation under the relaxed local differential privacy condition that the privatized distributions are $\alpha$-close in total variation distance. We show that adding independent noise with a convenient symmetrized Gamma distribution to each sensitive observation attains the $\alpha$-TV-LDP. We prove that the deconvolution estimator of $r$-Sobolev smooth functions attains the pointwise rate $(n\alpha)^{-\frac{2r-1}{2r}}$ up to log factors which is faster than $(n\alpha^2)^{-\frac{2r-1}{2r+1}}$ under the classical $\alpha$-LDP and closer to the nonprivate minimax rate $n^{-\frac{2r-1}{2r}}$. Next, we use a Goldenshluger-Lepski procedure to build a free of the smoothness adaptive procedure and show optimality of our rates in the convolution model of our privatisation scheme. translated_title: 松弛局部差分隐私下的更快学习
translated_abstract: 我们研究在松弛局部差分隐私条件下的密度估计问题，该条件要求私有化后的分布与原分布在全变差距离上α-接近。我们证明，对每个敏感观测添加独立的、具有对称化Gamma分布的噪声即可达到α-TV-LDP。我们证明，对于r-Sobolev光滑函数，反卷积估计器在逐点估计上达到了 (nα)^(-(2r-1)/(2r)) 的收敛速率（至多相差对数因子），这比经典α-LDP下的 (nα²)^(-(2r-1)/(2r+1)) 更快，且更接近非隐私的极小极大最优速率 n^(-(2r-1)/(2r))。接着，我们利用Goldenshluger-Lepski方法构建了无需光滑度信息的自适应程序，并证明了我们的速率在私有化方案的卷积模型中是最优的。我们通过实现一个无需添加更多噪声的神经网络估计器，展示了这一简单隐私机制的优势。
tldr: 提出一种基于对称化Gamma噪声的松弛局部差分隐私机制，使密度估计的收敛速率显著快于经典局部差分隐私并更接近非隐私的最优速率，同时实现了无需光滑度信息的自适应估计。
en_tdlr: Proposes a relaxed local differential privacy mechanism based on symmetrized Gamma noise, achieving density estimation rates faster than classical LDP and closer to the nonprivate minimax optimum, with an adaptive procedure free of smoothness assumptions.
